cohort: Children under the age of 18, with 171 having a diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder and 171 controls matched for gender, birth year, gestational age, and maternal age at birth.
finding: In male subjects, high duration and high cumulative dose of synthetic oxytocin during labor was significantly associated with elevated odds of developing autism spectrum disorder, while no significant associations were noted in female subjects.
mod_finding: Significantly elevated odds ratios for autism spectrum disorder were associated with first-time Cesarean section, but not a repeat Cesarean section.
